title: MicroSim Uniqueness Interactive Venn Diagram
description: An interactive three-circle Venn diagram demonstrating what makes MicroSims unique at the intersection of Simplicity, Accessibility, and AI Generation.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: MicroSim
learningObjectives: Define the three defining characteristics of a MicroSim: simplicity of scope and parameters, accessibility through iframe embedding on any device, and generation by language models from standardized patterns
Interpret a three-circle Venn diagram by distinguishing single-circle regions, pairwise overlaps, and the central intersection where all three sets meet
Explain why MicroSims sit only at the center, so that dropping any one of the three characteristics yields ordinary educational software rather than a MicroSim
Compare the pairwise overlap regions to describe what a tool gains and lacks when it has just two of the three characteristics
Predict which region a given educational artifact belongs to based on its scope, embeddability, and how it was authored
